name: Sparo PPT Deck Engine
description: Runtime-owned Manuscript revisions, AI-authored Design Case and VisualDocument pages, capability-aware semantic and visual review, and validated PowerPoint export.

capabilities.title: Sparo PPT Deck Engine
capabilities.description: Produce one presentation from an atomic manuscript through Design Case approval, ordered page visuals, whole-deck review, and export.

permissions.summary: Reads and writes the human-visible presentation folder, assets, previews, and PowerPoint file in the current workspace.
Starts the Node.js bridge worker that hosts the deck engine.
